title: United States land area & population density (social Areas)
description: The social face of Area: how a working society spans and packs a real extent. Each entry is a real, dated, sourced figure combining area (the extent a society occupies) with population (how densely it fills it). These are the area-and-density structures the BASIS reasons about for a working medium.

primary_sources: U.S. Census Bureau (population estimate; land area)
United Nations Statistics Division / CIA World Factbook (total area, via Wikipedia list)
provenance.note: Density = population / land area. Values are OBSERVED published figures; ASSOCIATION != CAUSATION.

areas.name: total_area
areas.source: UN Statistics Division / CIA World Factbook
areas.note: land + inland water within US boundaries

areas.name: population_density
areas.note: how densely the working society fills the land it spans
